automation_mode.review_loop: read exact source > reconcile no competing versions > run bounded tests > preserve evidence > report holds > await owner acceptance

open_workstreams.name: Owner acceptance of private rc.2
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Signed or recorded owner acceptance of the private evaluation scope and immutable rc.2 SHA256

open_workstreams.name: Source rights, licences, trademarks and open/paid recipe permissions
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Source-specific ownership/licence register for bundled and monetised objects; permitted free and paid distribution scope

open_workstreams.name: Independent security and privacy threat review
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Credential and privacy assessment, malicious-content tests, SAST/dependency assessment and explicit owner review

open_workstreams.name: Accessibility and cross-device user acceptance
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Browser/device accessibility and keyboard/mobile evidence, real user sign-off and known limitation list

open_workstreams.name: Publisher signing and distribution channel
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Owner-approved signing keys, publisher identity, final domain/download path and immutable release record

open_workstreams.name: Deployment rollback, support and commercial operating plan
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Tested rollout and rollback procedure, support owner, pricing/terms and customer disclosure approval

open_workstreams.name: Merge and source ancestry reconciliation
open_workstreams.required_evidence: PR #236 exact source review, CI, branch ancestry and preserved PR #232 contract dependencies; owner merge decision

open_workstreams.name: Native Object_ID, ACL, owner rights and DBR readback
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Authenticated source byte readback, accepted semantic identity, parent child ACL, independent owner DBR receipt

open_workstreams.name: Production trust roots and one-use challenge ledger
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Owner-approved key roots, revocation, globally atomic persistent nonce ledger, backup/recovery and authenticated host time

open_workstreams.name: FileSpace and LOAD native hydration interoperability
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Lease-bound native FileSpace resolver, source-body privacy isolation and independently replayed rights/rollback proof

open_workstreams.name: DataSpace and five-facet UniSpace convergence
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Independent DataSpace ledger/storage evidence and reconciliation with draft PR #232 five-facet parent topology

open_workstreams.name: PrintCeptor PC01 CAD, true geometry and C0
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Source-verified machine CAD, calibrated kinematics, tool reach and emergency stop/C0 safety acceptance

open_workstreams.name: Material lots and A→B/B→A directional coupons
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Traceable lots, interface chemistry, deposition order, measured bonded coupons and independent error bounds

open_workstreams.name: Atmospheres, encapsulation and 4D activation
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Purge/pressure/temperature exposure, encapsulation verification and stimulus-response cycling data

open_workstreams.name: Electronic function and diode-to-phone compliance
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Measured diode properties, PCB/IC provenance, EMC/RF, battery, thermal and functional safety evidence

open_workstreams.name: Terrestrial-to-in-situ scale qualification
open_workstreams.required_evidence: Scale-transfer uncertainty, vacuum/low-gravity and environmental witness qualification; independent validation
